question: Differences 44 and 45: predictions for the Edit Section panel at two frames not read before, pushed before any read at those frames.
from: CAP-P3PANEL, CAP-P3EDGE and CAP-P3JUMP at frames 945 and 1345, and one read at frame 945 on Blocks Probe of the real panel, not the slider's host. The panel is the [role=dialog] box, 320 by 476; recorder's 421 box is its inner host, 55 below its top. Panel tops read: open at H 667.6: 248; Custom, H 459.6: 195; 50: 195; 75: 207; 100: 279; 110: 310; 125: 404; 150: 435; 200: 435; 300: 435.

rule.moves: Inferred. While open and growing, top = section top in the frame + H/3 - 36, only if that is lower than where it is, it fits in the window (top + 476 <= window), and the height changed by less than 1000 in one step. Else it stays.
rule.closes: Inferred. It closes when H is more than 1.5 x frame + 1428 above the lowest H since it opened. The two frames read give 2835 to 2848 and 3441 to 3575.
rule.reopens: Scrolled so the section's middle is in the frame's middle, less 11. Panel top is the sticky Edit Section (73) + 49 = 122.
